card.name: Words around death and dates of death
card.fires_on: Words and digits right at a mention of death: the 'and' after 'cause of death', the year digits of a death date, or 'die'/'place' in 'death took place'. It is strongest in biographies, genealogy lists and chronic-disease statistics.

modes.label: Death-date digits
modes.description: Digits or punctuation inside birth-death years or a place of death in biographical text.
modes.example: Donald T Seiwert 1933 - 2010 - Anna Seiwert 1889 - 1<<9>>85 - Cheryl A Seiw

modes.label: Leading causes of death
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'death' in statements about disease as a cause of death and disability.
modes.example: are the leading causes of death<< and>> disability worldwide and account for 75

modes.label: Dying in a biography
modes.description: Verbs or nouns that describe how or where someone died.
modes.example: which took<< place>> on the 13th of March

card.writes: It suppresses cancer and disease words, so it makes a disease term less likely to come next.
card.plain: It fires in text about someone's death, such as death dates in biographies or 'cause of death' statements, and it makes the next word less likely to be cancer or disease.
